null_descriptions.ipr_iid_permutation: Permute IPR values iid relative to q; preserves marginal IPR distribution but destroys temporal dependence and q-IPR alignment.
null_descriptions.ipr_circular_shift: Circularly shift the full IPR trajectory relative to q; preserves the full IPR trajectory and autocorrelation while breaking calendar alignment.
null_descriptions.ipr_moving_block_resample: Moving-block resample IPR relative to fixed q; approximately preserves local IPR dependence while breaking q-IPR alignment.

note: High-replicate focused follow-up for the strongest observed candidates. It improves p-value precision for candidate-specific and top-candidate-set null audits, but it does not replace the full restricted-lattice multi-null audit and does not assert generator support.
